versions.content: Support for updating the Reporting Mode of Security Events Type: draft Description: In some cases, it is necessary to update the reporting mode of certain security events via diagnostic services. Rationale: The reporting mode of security events can be a very important part of a forensical analysis of an intrusion. Use Case: The user wants to update the reporting mode of a given security event. Dependencies: – Supporting Material:
